(3) Past losses in KLAC (-9.0%, 2026-08-20) and QCOM (-14.2%, 2026-07-30) confirm that semi equipment names do not hold under TNX>4.5% regime pressure. (4) The mandate explicitly states TNX above 4.5% and rising equals EXIT semis — LRCX, despite a BS score 10/10, is a semi equipment name and falls under this rule. (5) The Q1 earnings outperformance headline is the cited catalyst but earnings have already passed — 'thesis catalyst has expired or played out (earnings passed)' is a mandatory exit/no-entry trigger. (6) $18,000 would represent 9.8% of $183k, but with 3 semi-adjacent stop-losses in trade memory (QCOM, KLAC, AMD), the repeat-loss risk is unacceptably high at this TNX level. (7) ENTER is BLOCKED — this analysis is recorded as a formal PASS, not a trade; LRCX will be reconsidered when TNX falls below 4.5% or RSI resets below 50 with a fresh post-earnings catalyst.
